content:
Starting today, iPhone users who have installed the Suno app can generate songs via text or voice prompts within the Messages app. Here are the details.

Suno brings song generation to iMessage

Suno is one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, with more than 2 million paid subscribers and generating as many as 7 million songs daily.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also offers an iPhone app that lets users create and remix AI songs using text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. The platform also provides curated collections of user-created songs, editorial picks, and playlists organised by genre.

Now, Suno users can also create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. Once installed, the Suno app will appear alongside other iMessage apps in the Messages app's drawer menu, making it easy to generate songs through text prompts or voice memos without leaving the conversation.

Here's a real-world demo of the feature in action:

Suno says users can choose a genre before generating a song, regenerate to explore different versions, and then send the result into a conversation.

One potential limitation: Suno says both parties need to have the app installed to use this feature. However, for users who enjoy creating songs with AI, downloading this free app shouldn't be a problem.

Download Suno from the App Store.
